home.badgeLocal: Files are processed locally in your browser — never uploaded
home.faq1a: No. Parsing and conversion happen locally in your browser by default — your files never leave your device. Only very large files (in a future version) would use a server channel, and only with your explicit confirmation; data is deleted right after processing and never persisted.
home.faq1q: Will my statement data be uploaded?
home.faq2a: Yes — completely free right now, no sign-in required. Just upload a file to clean and export it; we recommend keeping single files under 2,000 rows for best browser performance.
home.faq3a: The MVP ships with four official presets: Amazon Settlement, Shopify Orders, TikTok Shop Financials, and Shopee; any CSV / XLSX format can also be handled with custom mapping.
home.faq4a: Both fixed-rate and monthly-average-rate modes are supported. Exports always keep four columns for verification: original amount, currency, rate, and converted amount; rates are for reference only — please reconcile against your actual settlement figures.
home.heroSubtitle: Amazon, Shopify, TikTok Shop, Shopee — drop in the raw statements exported from each platform. Encoding and fields are auto-detected, FX is converted, anomalies are highlighted, and a standard reconciliation sheet exports with one click.

tools.csvFix.whatBody: CSVs exported from cross-border platforms often mix UTF-8, GBK and UTF-16 encodings, and opening them directly in Excel garbles Chinese characters. This tool auto-detects the file encoding and converts it to UTF-8 with BOM, so it opens correctly on double-click. For batch multi-platform statements, field mapping and FX conversion, use the full CleanSheet workbench.

legal.terms.seoDesc: CleanSheet Terms of Service: free-use policy, user responsibilities, data handling and disclaimers.
legal.terms.s1: CleanSheet ("the Service") is a statement-data cleaning tool for cross-border e-commerce sellers, offering CSV / XLSX parsing, field mapping, FX conversion, anomaly detection and standard reconciliation-table export. The Service is provided via cleansheet.mrtion.kdns.fr.
legal.terms.s2: The Service is currently completely free and requires no sign-in. We reserve the right to change the pricing policy in the future; any change will be announced on this page in advance with a new effective date, and usage before the change is unaffected.
legal.terms.li3_1: You warrant that files you upload are data you lawfully hold or are entitled to process, and do not infringe any third party's intellectual property, trade secrets or other lawful rights.
legal.terms.li3_2: You must not use the Service for any activity violating laws or regulations, including but not limited to uploading malicious code or attacking the service infrastructure.
legal.terms.li3_3: If you register an account, keep your credentials safe; you bear losses arising from credential leaks.
legal.terms.s4: Statement files are parsed and converted locally in your browser by default; file contents are never uploaded to our servers. Only in scenarios you explicitly confirm (e.g. a future large-file server channel) will data travel over an encrypted channel, be deleted right after processing, and never be persisted. See the Privacy Policy for details.
legal.terms.li5_1: FX data provided by the conversion feature (including manual input and monthly average rates) is for reference only and is not financial or tax advice; verify actual settlement against your bank / platform statements.
legal.terms.li5_2: Conversion results are generated from your uploaded raw data and your mapping configuration — verify them yourself before using for bookkeeping.
legal.terms.li5_3: To the maximum extent permitted by law, the Service is provided "as is"; we are not liable for indirect losses arising from its use.
legal.terms.s6: The Service's interface, code, documentation and branding are owned by the operator. Files you upload, the data within, and cleaning templates you create remain yours.
legal.terms.s7: We may suspend or discontinue parts or all of the Service for maintenance, upgrades or business adjustments. Long-term termination will be announced 30 days in advance. We may suspend or delete your account if you violate these terms.
legal.terms.s8: These terms may be updated as the business evolves; updates will be posted on this page with a new "Last updated" date. Continued use of the Service constitutes acceptance of the updated terms.
legal.terms.s9: If you have any questions about these terms, reach us through the site's feedback channel or the admin email.
legal.privacy.title: Privacy Policy
legal.privacy.seoDesc: CleanSheet Privacy Policy: files are processed locally and never uploaded; what we collect, how we use and protect it.
legal.privacy.s1_intro: Depending on how you use the Service, we may collect:
legal.privacy.li1_1_text: : if you register, only your email address and a hashed password (we cannot see your plain-text password).
legal.privacy.li1_2_text: : counts such as conversions and rows processed for signed-in users, used for quota accounting.
legal.privacy.li1_3_text: : cleaning template configurations you actively save.
legal.privacy.li1_4_text: : to keep the service secure and stable, server logs may record anonymized access data (e.g. IP address, request time).
legal.privacy.s1_note: We do NOT collect the contents of your statement files (see section 2).
legal.privacy.s2: Statement files you upload are parsed, mapped and converted locally in your browser by default; contents are never uploaded to our servers. This is a core design principle of the Service. Only in scenarios you explicitly confirm (e.g. a future large-file server channel) will data travel over an encrypted channel, be deleted right after processing, and never be persisted.
legal.privacy.s3: Collected information is used only to: provide and maintain the Service, account for quotas, manage your templates, and keep accounts and the Service secure. We never sell, rent or share your personal information with third parties for marketing.
legal.privacy.s4: Data is stored on Cloudflare infrastructure (D1 database and KV storage) with reasonable technical safeguards, including hashed passwords, encrypted transport and access controls. No internet transmission can be guaranteed absolutely secure, however.
legal.privacy.s5: If you sign in, we use necessary session cookies to keep you logged in. Anonymous use requires no sign-in and sets no login cookies.
legal.privacy.li6_1: You can view your basic info and usage records on the account page at any time.
legal.privacy.li6_2: You can request deletion of your account and associated data; related templates and usage records will be unrecoverable afterwards.
legal.privacy.li6_3: To exercise these rights or with any privacy questions, reach us through the site's feedback channel or the admin email; we will respond within a reasonable time.
legal.privacy.s7: The Service is for users with full civil capacity; we do not knowingly collect minors' information.
legal.privacy.s8: This policy may be updated as the business evolves; updates will be posted on this page with a new "Last updated" date. Material changes will be flagged via site announcements.
